title: Jeweled Earthy Polish Rice Pilaf
description: A hearty, earthy Polish dish featuring Carnaroli rice, this pilaf is a quick-fix, macrobiotic-friendly option, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel. It combines the chewy texture of rice with the richness of mushrooms and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the grated carrots and sliced zucchini, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Carnaroli rice to the vessel, stirring to combine with the vegetables and oil.
Pour in the vegetable broth, adding salt and black pepper to taste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the vessel.
Simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
